When incapacitated, it loses 5 Might Points. Each time the character is wounded, part of its body is separated from the rest, and these pieces contain some of the character's vis, a number of pawns equal to ((total Wound penalty / 5) - the number of pawns already lost). For example, a Light wound would separate a pawn of vis from the character, and produce another pawn after five more Light wounds. All Magic Things have this Inferiority inherently, for no benefit.

entries.name: Elysian Ecstasy
entries.summary: After an hour of frenzy, channel a Greek god: (Characteristic) + Faerie Lore + aura + stress die against EF 9 to 21+ for the god's Personality Trait and Sympathy Traits for hours.
entries.description: A Mystery Lucian the Scholar of Merinita devised, initiated by his own script with himself as mystagogue; it needs no Outer Merinita Mysteries or Merinita Cult Lore. To use it the character works themself into the right state for an hour (meditation, song, storytelling, wild dance or drink), and may keep it up for extra hours, up to their Stamina, each adding +1 to the roll. The roll is the Characteristic that suits the god (Presence for Aphrodite, Strength for Herakles) + Faerie Lore + aura + a stress die, with the storyguide adding -3 to +3 for how closely the character's sex, looks and nature match the god, and up to +3 more if last season's deeds suited the god. Against Ease Factor 9 the character gains the god's Personality Trait at +2 and 1 point of Sympathy Traits; at 12, +3 and 3 points; at 15, +4 and 6; at 18, +5 and 10; at 21 or more, +6 and 15. Sympathy Trait points are bought as if they were Arts, and a Sympathy Trait stands in for a matching Ability's specialty but makes that roll a stress roll (Realms of Power: The Faerie). The traits last as many hours as the total rolled. A failed roll costs a Long-Term Fatigue level for each hour of preparation; a botch lets any faerie the storyguide chooses be channeled at any strength. A character who channels too well may be overwhelmed and become the god in the flesh.

entries.name: Olympian Pact
entries.summary: As Elysian Ecstasy, and a strong channeling also grants the god's minor or major powers, each use a Warping Point; initiation brings a Major Personality Flaw of the god's.
entries.description: The stronger and more dangerous form of Lucian the Scholar's Mystery, initiated with a Major Personality Flaw suited to the god whose powers are sought. It is used as Elysian Ecstasy and gives the same Personality and Sympathy Traits, and also some of the god's powers: at Ease Factor 12, one minor power; at 15, two minor powers; at 18, one major power or three minor ones; at 21 or more, two major powers, six minor ones, or one major and three minor. The powers last as long as the traits, and each use of one gives the character a Warping Point.

entries.name: {type} Controlling
entries.summary: Opens the elementalist Technique Controlling at 0 (Medicinal, Philosophical or Theurgical); Major for an elementalist's first Technique.
entries.description: Gives the elementalist Art Controlling, commanding and moving its targets, of one type: Medicinal, Philosophical or Theurgical. The first Technique an elementalist takes is a Major Virtue; further ones are Minor. The three types share one Art score.

entries.name: {type} Controlling
entries.summary: Opens another type of the elementalist Technique Controlling; Minor when it is not the elementalist's first Technique.
entries.description: As the Major version, for an elementalist who already has a Technique. Each Technique may be taken in up to three types (Medicinal, Philosophical, Theurgical), which share one Art score.

entries.name: {type} Divining
entries.summary: Opens the elementalist Technique Divining at 0 (Medicinal, Philosophical or Theurgical); Major for an elementalist's first Technique.
entries.description: Gives the elementalist Art Divining, sensing and communing with its targets, of one type: Medicinal, Philosophical or Theurgical. The first Technique an elementalist takes is a Major Virtue; further ones are Minor. The three types share one Art score.

entries.name: {type} Divining
entries.summary: Opens another type of the elementalist Technique Divining; Minor when it is not the elementalist's first Technique.
entries.description: As the Major version, for an elementalist who already has a Technique. Each Technique may be taken in up to three types (Medicinal, Philosophical, Theurgical), which share one Art score.

entries.name: {type} Refining
entries.summary: Opens the elementalist Technique Refining at 0 (Medicinal, Philosophical or Theurgical); Major for an elementalist's first Technique.
entries.description: Gives the elementalist Art Refining, seasonal refining of potions, Might and vis from its targets, of one type: Medicinal, Philosophical or Theurgical. The first Technique an elementalist takes is a Major Virtue; further ones are Minor. The three types share one Art score.

entries.name: {type} Refining
entries.summary: Opens another type of the elementalist Technique Refining; Minor when it is not the elementalist's first Technique.
entries.description: As the Major version, for an elementalist who already has a Technique. Each Technique may be taken in up to three types (Medicinal, Philosophical, Theurgical), which share one Art score.

entries.name: {type} Summoning
entries.summary: Opens the elementalist Technique Summoning at 0 (Medicinal, Philosophical or Theurgical); Major for an elementalist's first Technique.
entries.description: Gives the elementalist Art Summoning, calling up and binding its targets, of one type: Medicinal, Philosophical or Theurgical. The first Technique an elementalist takes is a Major Virtue; further ones are Minor. The three types share one Art score. Elemental Summoning is a different Art from the Goetic (spirit) Summoning.

entries.name: {type} Summoning
entries.summary: Opens another type of the elementalist Technique Summoning; Minor when it is not the elementalist's first Technique.
entries.description: As the Major version, for an elementalist who already has a Technique. Each Technique may be taken in up to three types (Medicinal, Philosophical, Theurgical), which share one Art score.

entries.name: Knowledge of True Names
entries.summary: 30 xp to spend on True Names of Magic, Faerie and Infernal beings, 5 xp each.
entries.description: Gives 30 xp to spend on True Names, 5 xp for each one; fewer than 5 in a name gives nothing. The Minor Virtue covers beings of Magic, Faerie and the Infernal. Taught among the mobeds; the storyguide may open it to sahirs and others.

entries.name: Knowledge of True Names
entries.summary: As the Minor Virtue, 30 xp on True Names, but also of angels and Divine beings.
entries.description: As the Minor version, 30 xp to spend on True Names at 5 xp each, but the names may also be those of angels and other Divine beings.

entries.name: Blessing of {ameshaspand}
entries.summary: +3 to Casting Scores of holy powers in one Ameshaspand's sphere.
entries.description: A holy mobed Mystery: +3 to the Casting Score of holy powers used in one Ameshaspand's sphere: Asha Vahishta (Ignem, Imaginem), Khshathra Vairya (Vim), Haurvatat (Aquam, Auram), Spenta Armaiti (Terram), Ameretat (Herbam), Vohu Manah (Animal) or Spenta Mainyu (Corpus, Mentem). One version per Ameshaspand.

entries.name: Mazdean Alchemy
entries.summary: A season distils Divine vis from a Divine aura: a tenth of the total in pawns.
entries.description: A holy mobed Mystery: a season spent distilling Divine vis from a Divine aura gives a tenth of Intelligence + Invocation + Wonders + modifiers (the aura and helpers among them) in pawns.

entries.name: Mazdean Astrology
entries.summary: Celestial Durations for holy powers, and the Celestial Blessing of a chosen hour.
entries.description: A holy mobed Mystery: the mobed may give holy powers the Celestial Durations (Minutes, Hours, Days, Signs) with an Intelligence + Artes Liberales roll, and may reckon an hour in which one activity gains +1 to +5 (Intelligence + Artes Liberales + simple die against four times the bonus).

entries.name: Righteousness of the Wise
entries.summary: A holy mobed Mystery; the book prints no rules for it.
entries.description: A holy mobed Mystery. The book describes it but gives it no game effect; the troupe decides what it does.

entries.name: Saoshyant's Elixir
entries.summary: Knows the level 50 rite of the elixir: no Aging rolls and no death while faithful, at a cost in Warping.
entries.description: A holy mobed Mystery: the mobed knows the rite (Invocation and Wonders, level 50, a season's preparation, an ordeal of molten metal and a sacrificed holy bull). While he keeps the faith he makes no Aging rolls and cannot die, but gains a Warping Point each year and whenever he would have aged, gained Decrepitude or died. Works on himself only.

entries.name: Gifts of Gayomart
entries.summary: Needs True Faith: gifts that grow with it, from no one lying to him to never dying of age.
entries.description: A holy mobed Mystery for one with True Faith. At True Faith 1 no one can lie to him; at 4 his Soak rises and he gains a commanding presence; at 6 he ages more slowly, heals better and regrows lost limbs; at 8 he never dies of age while he keeps a Faith Point from a purity rite, gaining Warping instead of Decrepitude.

entries.name: Control Fertility
entries.summary: Grants Control Fertility 1: make people, animals and crops fertile or barren.
entries.description: The character can strengthen or withdraw the vital force of living things, with the Supernatural Ability Control Fertility 1. Free with The Gift for the Scinnfolk.

entries.name: Warding
entries.summary: Grants Warding 1 (Accelerated): circles that keep out a chosen kind of thing.
entries.description: The character can enchant a drawn circle to keep out one kind of thing or being, with the Accelerated Supernatural Ability Warding 1. Taught by the Columbae.

entries.name: Banishing
entries.summary: Grants Banishing 1 (Accelerated): drive all creatures of a named realm from an area.
entries.description: The character can command every being of one realm to leave the place he stands in, with the Accelerated Supernatural Ability Banishing 1. It may be aligned to any realm. Taught by the Donatores Requietis Aeternae.

entries.name: Comprehend Magic
entries.summary: Grants Comprehend Magic 1: detect and analyse any magic.
entries.description: The character can sense magic and work out its nature, with the Supernatural Ability Comprehend Magic 1. Taught by the Lineage of Pralix.

entries.name: Craft Magic
entries.summary: Cast through crafted objects and make charged items in days, using a Craft score.
entries.description: The character works magic by making things: each effect is crafted into an object, whose shape and material add to it, and charged items can be made in days rather than a season. Needs a Craft or Profession score and another source of magic. Taught by the Rustic Magi.

entries.name: Sihr
entries.summary: Grants Sihr 1 (Accelerated): summon jinn and bind them by bargain.
entries.description: The character can summon a jinni and power the bargain that puts it in his service, with the Accelerated Supernatural Ability Sihr 1. Practised by the Hermetic Sahirs and the sahirs of the Levant.

entries.name: Siren Song
entries.summary: Her singing gives one command to all who hear it, rolled with Communication + Music.
entries.description: The singer's music can command those who hear it to do one thing while the song lasts; the target resists with Stamina, more strongly against a dangerous command. Taught by the Seirenes.

entries.name: Ring/Circle Magic
entries.summary: Draws circles at twice the speed; Concentration only if the circle is broken while casting.
entries.description: The Columbae magus draws a Ring or Circle twice as fast as others, and need roll Concentration only if the circle is broken while it is being cast, not to keep the spell up.

entries.name: Root-Cutter
entries.summary: Cuts a healing Ritual's vis cost by the Mythic Herbalism score, at most by half.
entries.description: The magus prepares magical ingredients that lower the vis cost of a healing Ritual by his Mythic Herbalism score, never by more than half. Taught by the Pharmacopoeians.

entries.name: Spell Foci
entries.summary: One shape or material bonus per spell, up to Magic Theory (or Craft with Craft Magic).
entries.description: Each spell may be designed around one focus that adds a shape or material bonus, up to Magic Theory (or the Craft score with Craft Magic). A spell designed with a focus can't be cast without it. Foci can also boost spontaneous spells.

entries.name: Solomonic Alchemy
entries.summary: Grants Solomonic Alchemy 0: change non-living matter through a summoned spirit.
entries.description: The character knows the Solomonic art Alchemy at 0, an Accelerated Supernatural Ability he uses through a spirit he has summoned. An unGifted sahir usually has only one Solomonic art.

entries.name: Solomonic Astrology
entries.summary: Grants Solomonic Astrology 0: learn about a target through a summoned spirit.
entries.description: The character knows the Solomonic art Astrology at 0, an Accelerated Supernatural Ability he uses through a spirit he has summoned. An unGifted sahir usually has only one Solomonic art.

entries.name: Solomonic Physic
entries.summary: Grants Solomonic Physic 0: heal or harm a body through a summoned spirit.
entries.description: The character knows the Solomonic art Physic at 0, an Accelerated Supernatural Ability he uses through a spirit he has summoned. An unGifted sahir usually has only one Solomonic art.

entries.name: Solomonic Storytelling
entries.summary: Grants Solomonic Storytelling 0: sway listeners through a summoned spirit.
entries.description: The character knows the Solomonic art Storytelling at 0, an Accelerated Supernatural Ability he uses through a spirit he has summoned. An unGifted sahir usually has only one Solomonic art.

entries.name: Solomonic Travel
entries.summary: Grants Solomonic Travel 0: open passages and wards through a summoned spirit.
entries.description: The character knows the Solomonic art Travel at 0, an Accelerated Supernatural Ability he uses through a spirit he has summoned. An unGifted sahir usually has only one Solomonic art.

entries.name: Sahir
entries.summary: Member of the Suhhar Sulayman and a bayt al-hikma; owes the Suhhar one season a year.
entries.description: The sahir belongs to the Suhhar Sulayman and to a house of wisdom. He owes the Suhhar a season a year and may take Academic and Arcane Abilities at creation. It may be taken beside another Social Status. A member who cannot really summon a spirit must also take Dark Secret.

entries.name: Vizier
entries.summary: A sahir who sits and speaks at the Majlis; Reputation 3 among the Suhhar.
entries.description: Only for a Sahir. He attends the Suhhar's council, the Majlis, and may speak there, and has a Reputation of 3 among the Suhhar, good or bad.

entries.name: Mustajib
entries.summary: A Nizari sahir: must have Sihr; Gifted ones are Opened to all the Solomonic arts.
entries.description: The Nizari sahir's status. He must summon with Sihr. A Gifted mustajib is Opened to every Solomonic art; an unGifted one buys the arts as Virtues or is initiated into them, and should take Necessary Condition and Prohibition. May take Academic and Arcane Abilities at creation.

entries.name: Invocation of Names of Power
entries.summary: Invents Names of Power whose bonus adds to a later spell or summoning in their domain.
entries.description: The sahir invents Names of Power the way he invents summoning spells, a Name's level being five times its bonus. Speaking a Name (a round each) adds its bonus to the next spell or summoning in its domain; the Names on one casting may add no more than his Finesse. A botch angers the being named.

entries.name: Yatu Magic
entries.summary: His effects count as Magic or Faerie, whichever aura suits better; no Warping from those auras.
entries.description: The yatu's magic counts as Magic or Faerie, whichever gives the better aura modifier, and he gains no Warping from living in Magic or Faerie auras.

entries.name: Bound Spells
entries.summary: Each naranj works only through the spirit present when it was invented.
entries.description: Every spell works only through the spirit that was present when he invented it. Re-inventing it for another spirit takes a season, as if from a lab text.

entries.name: Patron
entries.summary: Serves a powerful patron who listens to him and grants favours.
entries.description: The character serves a powerful patron. As a Minor Flaw he has the patron's ear and gets favours in return for his service.

entries.name: Patron
entries.summary: Must obey a powerful patron, with no reward.
entries.description: The character serves a powerful patron whom he must obey, and gets nothing for it.

entries.name: {realm} Spirit Companion
entries.summary: An intelligent spirit companion of a realm; how closely it obeys depends on its Might.
entries.description: An intelligent spirit of the chosen realm keeps the character company. One of Might about 5 obeys closely, about 10 follows orders loosely, and 15 or more does as it pleases. An Infernal companion is a Major Flaw.

entries.name: Infernal Spirit Companion
entries.summary: An intelligent Infernal spirit companion; how closely it obeys depends on its Might.
entries.description: The Infernal form of (Realm) Spirit Companion: a demon keeps the character company, obeying more loosely the stronger it is.

entries.name: Submitted Qareen
entries.summary: One's faerie qareen has accepted Islam and guards like a Ghostly Warder.
entries.description: The character's qareen, the Faerie jinni born beside him, has accepted Islam. It acts as a Ghostly Warder, but gives no general Magic Resistance.

entries.name: Jinni
entries.summary: Marks a spirit of the Islamic lands as a jinni: a true name that can be learnt, Arabic, Theology: Islam (jinn), a power to hide; Sihr summons only jinn.
entries.description: The being is one of the jinn, the spirits at home in the lands of Islam, from Iberia and the Maghreb to Transoxiana, of whichever realm its answer to the Prophet's teaching put it in: Faerie if it took Islam, dark Faerie if it refused it, Magic if it paid no heed, Infernal if it fights it. There are no Divine jinn. Every jinni has a true name that can be learnt, however small its Might; nearly all know classical Arabic, as an Ability, a Pretense or by magic (a few old ones only Aramaic, Hebrew or a lost tongue); it has Theology: Islam (jinn), as a Pretense if it is a faerie; and it has some power to hide, such as invisibility, an immaterial or illusory body, or an animal shape. Sihr summons only beings with this Virtue. Ghosts, demons that are not jinn, the spirits of Europe and physical creatures with a Might are not jinn, and the storyguide settles any doubtful case.

entries.name: 'Afrit Blood
entries.summary: Faerie Blood from a jinni line: +1 to Strength or Intelligence (to at most +3).
entries.description: A Faerie Blood variant for a descendant of jinn, giving +1 to Strength or Intelligence (to at most +3). A stronger legacy (Strong Faerie Blood) raises it further.

entries.name: Jann Blood
entries.summary: Faerie Blood from a jinni line: +1 to Presence (to at most +3).
entries.description: A Faerie Blood variant for a descendant of jinn, giving +1 to Presence (to at most +3). A stronger legacy (Strong Faerie Blood) raises it further.

entries.name: Ghula Blood
entries.summary: Faerie Blood from a jinni line: retractable claws (Init -1, Atk +2, Dfn +3, Dam +2).
entries.description: A Faerie Blood variant for a descendant of jinn, giving retractable claws (Init -1, Atk +2, Dfn +3, Dam +2). A stronger legacy (Strong Faerie Blood) raises it further.

entries.name: Blood of the Old Gods
entries.summary: Faerie Blood of Egypt's old gods: a Sympathy Trait may reach Warping Score +1, and botches with Sympathy Traits give a Warping Point for each zero (Lands of the Nile p. 36).
entries.description: A Faerie Blood variant descended from the old gods of Egypt. The character has a Sympathy Trait of +1 and can take one more Warping before its limit, but his botches cause Warping.

entries.name: Blood of the Old Gods
entries.summary: A variety of Strong Faerie Blood, of Egypt's old gods: a Sympathy Trait may reach Warping Score +2, and botches with Sympathy Traits give a Warping Point for each zero (Lands of the Nile p. 36).
entries.description: The Major form of Blood of the Old Gods: as the Minor, but the Warping limit rises by 2.

entries.name: Soban Alchemy
entries.summary: Grants Soban Alchemy: change one property of inanimate matter with a dose of reagent.
entries.description: The character has the Supernatural Ability Soban Alchemy. The Gifted can also learn it from books; the unGifted need this Virtue or the Ministry's initiation.

entries.name: Alchemist of Soba
entries.summary: Serves Soba's Ministry two or more seasons a year; Academic Abilities; needs Philosophiae 3.
entries.description: A member of Soba's alchemists. He may take Academic Abilities and must have Philosophiae 3 or more. He owes the Ministry at least two seasons a year (Exposure only, no reagent of his own) unless Wealthy or protected, and may spend one free season making reagent at the city's cost, half of it for its use.

entries.name: Dedun's Blessing
entries.summary: Can align a Magic aura to the dead, doubling it for matching work.
entries.description: The Altar Priest's gift. With a ceremony each season for a year, then Int + Magic Lore + stress die against 9 + the aura (+1 for each year of trying), he aligns a Magic aura to the dead; it then counts double for work to do with the dead. A botch aligns it to something else.

entries.name: Unnatural Vitality
entries.summary: +3 x Decrepitude to Casting and Lab Totals; need not die at Decrepitude 5.
entries.description: The Temple Priest's gift. He adds three times his Decrepitude to his Casting and Lab Totals, and the same amount cancels penalties; he has no Crisis from stress above Decrepitude 4, does not have to die at Decrepitude 5, and takes -3 on Crisis Totals. He also keeps a Court of corpses.

entries.name: Transformed Human
entries.summary: Becomes a Magic Human of Corpus with Might bought from his Court; no aging or Warping.
entries.description: The Undying One's gift. He becomes a Magic Human of Form Corpus, buying Might as if it were an Art with his Court's strength as xp, after which it is fixed. He is immune to deprivation, Warping and aging, has a monstrous look, and counts as dead: an aura aligned to the dead adds twice its strength to his Magic Resistance, and Kassalan exorcism works on him.

entries.name: Disjunction
entries.summary: Grants Disjunction 0 (Accelerated): strip The Gift and Supernatural Virtues through settut amulets.
entries.description: The settut power Disjunction at 0, an Accelerated Supernatural Ability worked through amulets. A Gifted settut is Opened to her branch's powers without buying them.

entries.name: Dislocation
entries.summary: Grants Dislocation 0 (Accelerated): shorten a journey through settut amulets.
entries.description: The settut power Dislocation at 0, an Accelerated Supernatural Ability worked through amulets. A Gifted settut is Opened to her branch's powers without buying them.

entries.name: Dismay
entries.summary: Grants Dismay 0 (Accelerated): block a group of Abilities with an insult through settut amulets.
entries.description: The settut power Dismay at 0, an Accelerated Supernatural Ability worked through amulets. A Gifted settut is Opened to her branch's powers without buying them.

entries.name: Dismissal
entries.summary: Grants Dismissal 0 (Accelerated): expel creatures of a realm from an area through settut amulets.
entries.description: The settut power Dismissal at 0, an Accelerated Supernatural Ability worked through amulets. A Gifted settut is Opened to her branch's powers without buying them.

entries.name: Dissidence
entries.summary: Grants Dissidence 0 (Accelerated): turn one person against another through settut amulets.
entries.description: The settut power Dissidence at 0, an Accelerated Supernatural Ability worked through amulets. A Gifted settut is Opened to her branch's powers without buying them.

entries.name: Dissolution
entries.summary: Grants Dissolution 0 (Accelerated): weaken or destroy lifeless matter through settut amulets.
entries.description: The settut power Dissolution at 0, an Accelerated Supernatural Ability worked through amulets. A Gifted settut is Opened to her branch's powers without buying them.

entries.name: Settut Divination
entries.summary: Grants Settut Divination 0: the seeress's art of answering questions as Intellego spells.
entries.description: Makes the settut a seeress (tineqiqqit), with the Accelerated Supernatural Ability Settut Divination at 0. It is never Favored; apprenticeship xp may go into it.

entries.name: Settut
entries.summary: A settut witch: makes amulets of her powers, Arcane Abilities, Tamzawit Curse, 2 seasons a year of work.
entries.description: The settut's status, which can't be held with any other Social Status. She may make amulets of her powers and take Arcane Abilities at creation, suffers the Tamzawit Curse in place of the usual Warping, belongs to a local convocation, and spends two seasons a year supporting herself.

entries.name: Geomancy
entries.summary: Grants Geomancy 1: allegorical answers about a recent event touching a connected person.
entries.description: The character has the Supernatural Ability Geomancy at 1. It may also be a Major Mystery Virtue gained by initiation.

entries.name: Astrological Geomancy
entries.summary: Int + Artes Liberales + die vs 9 gives +3 to a Geomancy total about a target.
entries.description: Adds the stars to geomancy: Int + Artes Liberales + a die against 9 gives +3 to a Geomancy Casting Total about a particular target. Outside the Middle East it needs a story to learn.

entries.name: Skilled Geomancer
entries.summary: 50 xp among geomancy-related Abilities; grants no Supernatural Ability.
entries.description: 50 xp to spend among Divination (geomancy), Dowsing, Geomancy, a (Realm) Lore, Profession: Soothsayer and Wilderness Sense. It gives no Supernatural Ability by itself.

entries.name: Lesser Geomancy
entries.summary: (Sta + a Realm Lore + aura + die) / 2 casts magical senses of health, wealth and mind.
entries.description: With a chosen (Realm) Lore as its key (which also sets its realm), the character casts magical senses of health, wealth and mental state, designed as Hermetic Intellego Corpus, Mentem or Terram spells. Each try takes 15 minutes and a Fatigue level; the Casting Total is (Sta + Lore + aura + stress die) / 2.

entries.name: Inenden Crafter
entries.summary: Makes ability-swapping and ability-boosting tools or jewellery; includes Crafter's Eye.
entries.description: The inenden's craft magic: the equivalents of Maker of Water Vessels and Maker of Textured Vessels, but for wooden or metal tools (men) or glass or metal jewellery (women). It includes Crafter's Eye (Eye of Hephaestus).

entries.name: Mythic {craft}
entries.summary: Makes wondrous items of one Form that affect only a camel or its surroundings.
entries.description: Mythic Saddle-Maker and its kin (Mythic Blacksmith, Woodcarver, Jeweler): the crafter makes wondrous items of one Form that affect only the camel or its immediate surroundings, with a Craft Total of Int or Dex (fixed at creation) + the Craft. Taken a second time it adds a second Form or a second Craft, not both.

entries.name: Theriomorph
entries.summary: In human form, takes on one Quality or Virtue of his animal (Stamina vs 6, a round).
entries.description: Needs Shapeshifter, Skinchanger or Lycanthrope. In human form he takes on one Quality or Virtue of his chosen animal with a Stamina roll against 6 (a round; the same roll drops it). It counts as a constant mystical effect for Warping, and onlookers may need a Brave roll against 9 + his Warping Score. The bouda may also take it as a Mystery Virtue.

entries.name: Bouda Blood
entries.summary: Faerie Blood of the werehyena: +1 to Strength or Intelligence (to at most +3).
entries.description: A Faerie Blood variant for a descendant of a Faerie bouda, giving +1 to Strength or Intelligence (to at most +3); a stronger legacy raises the limit by 1.

entries.name: Murabit
entries.summary: A Maghrebi holy man: Blessing, Ceremony, Craft Amulets, Dream Interpretation and Understanding are Favored.
entries.description: The murabit belongs to a holy tradition whose five Favored Abilities are Blessing, Ceremony, Craft Amulets, Dream Interpretation and Understanding. He may take Dominion Lore and Theology at creation.

entries.name: Talib
entries.summary: A student and follower of a murabit's brotherhood; Academic or Martial Abilities.
entries.description: The talib follows a murabit's brotherhood as a student. He may take Academic or Martial Abilities at creation, and should think of Oath of Fealty or a Vow.

entries.name: Branchidae Prophecy
entries.summary: Interprets an oracle's visions into prophecy texts that give Prophecy Points.
entries.description: The magus can interpret the visions of an oracle who drank a vis-charged draught of Sacred Spring water, writing them up as a prophecy that gives its readers a Prophecy Point. Only gained at a Branchidae's Opening.

entries.name: Potent Sorcery
entries.summary: +3 to Casting Totals inside a narrow focus, or +3 plus a casting tool's Shape and Material bonus.
entries.description: A non-Hermetic counterpart of a Magical Focus. Inside a focus narrower than one Supernatural Ability (a kind of target or a situation), the character adds +3 to Casting Totals, or +3 plus the Shape and Material bonus of a tool used in casting; outside it, tools give nothing. Only one may ever be taken, and never with Hermetic magic (use Potent Magic).

entries.name: Lesser Craft Magic
entries.summary: Crafts objects already holding vis into lesser devices carrying an effect of one of his Supernatural Abilities.
entries.description: The craftsman makes an object whose raw material already holds vis into a lesser enchanted device with an effect of a Supernatural Ability he has. His Casting Total serves as the Lab Total and need only reach the Ease Factor; the effect's level is at most 5 times the pawns in the object, and he may invest no more pawns a season than his Ability score. A self-only Virtue may be invested instead, using a Craft Total. Shape and Material bonuses apply, capped by the Ability used.

entries.name: Known Wizard
entries.summary: The Order of Hermes knows of him, roughly where he lives and what he can do.
entries.description: The Order of Hermes knows the wizard exists, roughly where he lives and what his magic can do. He may be offered the choice to join or die.

entries.name: Pagan
entries.summary: Unbaptized and observant of an old faith; may start with Magic Lore or Faerie Lore.
entries.description: The character is unbaptized and keeps a pagan faith, and may start with Magic Lore or Faerie Lore. Rival Magic's Story version, for sagas that will tell stories about that faith; ArM5's Personality Flaw of the same name is separate.

entries.name: Amazon
entries.summary: A woman warrior in good standing in Amazonia; may buy Martial Abilities at creation.
entries.description: The character is an Amazon warrior of good standing in her community, and may buy Martial Abilities at character creation. Other Social Status Virtues and Flaws are closed to Amazons.

entries.name: Amazon Sorceress
entries.summary: A Gifted Amazon sorceress with her own temple in a Magic aura of 1, outside Amazonia.
entries.description: The character is a Gifted Amazon sorceress. She starts with a temple outside Amazonia in a Magic aura of 1, and may learn any Ability open to Amazons, Martial and Arcane included.

entries.name: Amazonian Slave
entries.summary: A male slave of the Amazons; one born there may take no Virtue giving Martial Abilities.
entries.description: The character is a male slave of the Amazons, born in Amazonia or taken in a raid. One born there to an Amazon mother may take no Virtue that opens Martial Abilities; a captive may have earlier weapon skills.

entries.name: Martial Connection to Magic
entries.summary: Each season, 2+ xp in Martial Abilities also gives 1 xp in Finesse, and 2+ xp in Finesse 1 xp in a Martial Ability.
entries.description: Her fighting and her magic feed each other. A season in which she gains at least 2 xp in Martial Abilities also gives 1 xp in Finesse (at most 1 a season), and one in which she gains at least 2 xp in Finesse gives 1 xp in a Martial Ability.

entries.name: Strong Magic
entries.summary: Targets resist her spells against a base Ease Factor of 9 instead of 6.
entries.description: Her magic is harder to resist: the Resistance Roll against her spells starts from an Ease Factor of 9 instead of 6.

entries.name: Symbolic Understanding
entries.summary: Each time study raises one Vowel, the other two Vowels gain 1 xp each.
entries.description: She sees the three Vowels as the beginning, middle and end of one cycle. Whenever she raises one Vowel through study, each of the other two gains 1 xp.

entries.name: Proven Raider
entries.summary: +50 xp in Martial Abilities at character creation.
entries.description: She has shown her worth on several raids, and has 50 extra xp to spend on Martial Abilities at character creation.

entries.name: Skilled Mistress
entries.summary: +60 xp at creation from a more able mistress; no extra spell levels.
entries.description: The Amazon version of Skilled Parens: her mistress was more able than most, giving 60 extra xp at character creation but no extra spell levels.

entries.name: Frail Magic
entries.summary: Targets resist her spells against a base Ease Factor of 3 instead of 6.
entries.description: Her magic is weaker than her sisters' and easier to resist: the Resistance Roll against her spells starts from an Ease Factor of 3 instead of 6.

entries.name: Poor Incantation Magic
entries.summary: The Amazon form of Poor Formulaic Magic, for her incantations.
entries.description: The Amazon version of Poor Formulaic Magic, applying to her incantations; a Major Flaw for a sorceress.

entries.name: Clumsy Magic (Amazon)
entries.summary: Clumsy Magic for an Amazon sorceress, Major because every incantation must be aimed.
entries.description: Clumsy Magic works as usual, but is a Major Flaw for an Amazon sorceress because every incantation she sings must be aimed.

entries.name: Harnessed Magic (Amazon)
entries.summary: Harnessed Magic for an Amazon sorceress, Major because her Durations run much longer.
entries.description: Harnessed Magic works as usual, but is a Major Virtue for an Amazon sorceress, whose Durations can be far longer than a magus's.

entries.name: Short-Lived Magic (Amazon)
entries.summary: A simple die cuts the Chant multiplier on her Durations by 1 to 3, or shortens the Duration a step on a 10.
entries.description: For each spell roll a simple die: 1 to 3 counts her Amazonian Chant one lower for its Duration, 4 to 6 two lower, 7 to 9 three lower, and a 10 makes the Duration one step shorter. Nothing lasts less than Momentary.

entries.name: Unpredictable Magic (Amazon)
entries.summary: She always rolls a stress die both to cast and to aim an incantation.
entries.description: Unpredictable Magic for an Amazon sorceress: she must always roll a stress die both for casting and for aiming an incantation.

entries.name: Beloved Slave
entries.summary: A male slave whose Amazon mother loves him and eases his life where she can.
entries.description: The slave's Amazon mother loves him and does what she can to make his life easier; he may live outside the slave quarters as a personal attendant or still with her.

entries.name: Bitter Mistress
entries.summary: Her former mistress loathes her and works to humiliate and obstruct her, by violence if need be.
entries.description: Her former mistress loathes her and does all she can to humiliate and obstruct her. With no custom forbidding violence between sorceresses, this is worse than Tormenting Master.

entries.name: Friendly Mistress
entries.summary: An allied former mistress, kept by a season assisting in her temple every other year.
entries.description: Her former mistress is fond of her and an ally who offers aid, but keeping the friendship costs a season assisting in the mistress's temple every other year, and the mistress often asks for help.

entries.name: Magic Aura Temple
entries.summary: Her temple stands in a Magic aura of 3, which others try to take from her.
entries.description: She starts with her temple in a Magic aura of 3 instead of 1, and others try to take it from her by political, social or violent means.

entries.name: Prolonged Apprenticeship
entries.summary: Still treated as an apprentice after her fifteen years of training.
entries.description: After her fifteen years she is still treated as her mistress's apprentice.

entries.name: Court Wizard
entries.summary: A Virgilian court wizard: Reputation 1, an employer, a laboratory, +1 Living Conditions; owes a season a year.
entries.description: The Augustan wizard serves a noble employer, who gives him a laboratory, servants and guards, and +1 Living Conditions; he has the Reputation Court Wizard 1 among mundanes and magi. He must give the employer at least one season a year, cannot join the Order of Hermes, and may also take a second Social Status for his former career.

entries.name: Generous Master
entries.summary: +72 xp in apprenticeship on rites, Brotherhood Abilities and Arts, and Organization Lore: Augustan Brotherhood.
entries.description: The Augustan counterpart of Skilled Parens: 72 extra xp at creation, to spend on rites, the Brotherhood's Supernatural Abilities and Arts, and Organization Lore: Augustan Brotherhood.

entries.name: Sjonhverfing
entries.summary: Grants Sjonhverfing 1.
entries.description: Gives the Supernatural Ability Sjonhverfing at 1. Visual illusions up to the size of a hut, lasting an hour or until dismissed; a sharp-eyed viewer sees the flaws. Anyone may take it, but only a Muspelli can use it in utiseta.

entries.name: Spadomur
entries.summary: Grants Spadomur 1.
entries.description: Gives the Supernatural Ability Spadomur at 1. Allegorical visions of present events through an Arcane or Sympathetic Connection, about an hour's trance, helped by a fitting reflecting surface. Anyone may take it, but only a Muspelli can use it in utiseta.

entries.name: Storm's Eye
entries.summary: Grants Storm's Eye 1.
entries.description: Gives the Supernatural Ability Storm's Eye at 1. Raises fog, rain or storms around himself or a touched person or object, moving with them, until dismissed or sunrise; he is immune to it. Anyone may take it, but only a Muspelli can use it in utiseta.

entries.name: Threads of Fate
entries.summary: Grants Threads of Fate 1.
entries.description: Gives the Supernatural Ability Threads of Fate at 1. Twists his own luck for a named event: favored rolls, pre-rolled dice, fewer botch dice, rerolls; baleful versions curse others. Anyone may take it, but only a Muspelli can use it in utiseta.

entries.name: Valgaldrar
entries.summary: Grants Valgaldrar 1.
entries.description: Gives the Supernatural Ability Valgaldrar at 1. Necromancy on an intact, unburied corpse: makes it speak, tell the truth, or rise and obey while he is in sight. Anyone may take it, but only a Muspelli can use it in utiseta.

entries.name: Wildfire
entries.summary: Grants Wildfire 1.
entries.description: Gives the Supernatural Ability Wildfire at 1. Commands an existing fire within 15 paces: spreads, intensifies or moves it; with utiseta, lava and volcanoes. Always +2 botch dice. Anyone may take it, but only a Muspelli can use it in utiseta.

entries.name: Winter's Breath
entries.summary: Grants Winter's Breath 1.
entries.description: Gives the Supernatural Ability Winter's Breath at 1. Drumming brings cold to a 100-pace circle, from chill and frost to blizzards, and freezes water; magical, so it must penetrate. Anyone may take it, but only a Muspelli can use it in utiseta.

entries.name: Muspelli
entries.summary: A sorcerer sworn to an imprisoned jotun, with six favored Supernatural Abilities set by the patron.
entries.description: The Muspelli's Social Status, taken like Hermetic Magus: access to the six Supernatural Abilities his jotun patron grants. Known among Norse magicians, the affiliation counts as the Outsider Major Flaw.

entries.name: Soqotran Sorcerer
entries.summary: A Gifted sorcerer of Soqotra: a spirit ally, a tree giving 120 sparks of vis a year, all four styles at 0.
entries.description: The Soqotran sorcerer's Social Status, in place of Hermetic Magus. Access to Finesse, Magic Lore, Penetration, Artes Liberales and Martial Abilities; a spirit ally; a tree giving 120 sparks (12 pawns) of vis a year; all four styles of magic at 0 and favored, and his tribe's may exceed the age cap. Vis is needed for every spell (that Flaw is built in), and he must do what the spirits ask.

entries.name: Senior Soqotran Sorcerer
entries.summary: A respected senior sorcerer whose spirit is an aide: he may spend twice as much of its Might when casting.
entries.description: For respected, powerful sorcerers, rarely under 35. His spirit is an aide rather than an ally, so he may spend up to twice his Ability score in its Might Pool on a spell.

entries.name: Spirit Ally
entries.summary: The spirit is bound to a Soqotran sorcerer: an Arcane Connection to him, and its Might helps his casting.
entries.description: A spirit's Virtue for its bond to a Soqotran sorcerer. It needs no Acclimation, shares an Arcane Connection with him and his other allies, sensing his direction and mood, and while touching him extends his Touch range. It spends its Might Pool to raise his Casting Totals in its tribe's magic, or the same to dispel a spell its Might helped create.

entries.name: Vulnerability (Tree)
entries.summary: The spirit dies or is banished if its tree is destroyed; the tree shares its Magic Resistance.
entries.description: The spirit is bound to a tree: if the tree is destroyed, it dies or is banished. The tree shares its Magic Resistance, and it senses harm to the tree and finds it with Concentration + Awareness vs 6.

entries.name: Canaanite Necromancy
entries.summary: Grants Canaanite Necromancy 1: speak with, command or summon the dead.
entries.description: Gives the Supernatural Ability Canaanite Necromancy at 1, to communicate with, command or summon the dead as Corpus or Mentem effects. It is of the Magic realm, though an Infernal version exists.

entries.name: Defixio Lore
entries.summary: Grants Defixio Lore 1: curse tablets in the Arts of the cults he knows (one per point).
entries.description: Gives the Supernatural Ability Defixio Lore at 1. He knows one defixio cult per point (Ceres, Hecate, Minerva, Pluto, Proserpina), each tied to one Technique and Form, and makes curse tablets with their effects.

entries.name: Mechanica of Heron
entries.summary: Grants Mechanica of Heron 1: build natural-philosophy devices that work without enchantment. Needs The Gift.
entries.description: Gives the Supernatural Ability Mechanica of Heron at 1. The character must have The Gift and a Virtue that gives Academic Abilities. He builds mechanica, devices of natural philosophy that simulate Creo, Rego, Perdo or Muto effects on Auram, Aquam, Ignem, Mentem or Terram, and can animate simulacra of living things.

entries.name: Araqiel's Secret
entries.summary: Vis of Creo, Terram and Corpus is interchangeable, and requisites among them may be ignored.
entries.description: A Secret of the Grigori, a Supernatural (Divine) Virtue. A holder who can use the Arts Creo, Terram and Corpus may use vis of any of the three for the others, and ignore requisites among them. Using that vis, or a spell that ignores a requisite this way, in a Divine or Infernal aura doubles the botch dice.

entries.name: Armaros's Secret
entries.summary: Vis of Rego, Imaginem and Vim is interchangeable, and requisites among them may be ignored.
entries.description: A Secret of the Grigori, a Supernatural (Divine) Virtue. A holder who can use the Arts Rego, Imaginem and Vim may use vis of any of the three for the others, and ignore requisites among them. Using that vis, or a spell that ignores a requisite this way, in a Divine or Infernal aura doubles the botch dice.

entries.name: Azael's Secret
entries.summary: Vis of Perdo, Terram and Imaginem is interchangeable, and requisites among them may be ignored.
entries.description: A Secret of the Grigori, a Supernatural Virtue tied to the Infernal, unlike the other Secrets (Ancient Magic p. 73). A holder who can use the Arts Perdo, Terram and Imaginem may use vis of any of the three for the others, and ignore requisites among them. Using that vis, or a spell that ignores a requisite this way, in a Divine or Infernal aura doubles the botch dice. Azael's teaching also gives the Corrupted Abilities Flaw.

entries.name: Baraqijal and Kokabel's Secret
entries.summary: Vis of Intellego, Mentem and Imaginem is interchangeable, and requisites among them may be ignored.
entries.description: A Secret of the Grigori, a Supernatural (Divine) Virtue. A holder who can use the Arts Intellego, Mentem and Imaginem may use vis of any of the three for the others, and ignore requisites among them. Using that vis, or a spell that ignores a requisite this way, in a Divine or Infernal aura doubles the botch dice.

entries.name: Ezeqeel's Secret
entries.summary: Vis of Muto, Aquam and Auram is interchangeable, and requisites among them may be ignored.
entries.description: A Secret of the Grigori, a Supernatural (Divine) Virtue. A holder who can use the Arts Muto, Aquam and Auram may use vis of any of the three for the others, and ignore requisites among them. Using that vis, or a spell that ignores a requisite this way, in a Divine or Infernal aura doubles the botch dice.

entries.name: Sariel's Secret
entries.summary: Vis of Perdo, Mentem and Ignem is interchangeable, and requisites among them may be ignored.
entries.description: A Secret of the Grigori, a Supernatural (Divine) Virtue. A holder who can use the Arts Perdo, Mentem and Ignem may use vis of any of the three for the others, and ignore requisites among them. Using that vis, or a spell that ignores a requisite this way, in a Divine or Infernal aura doubles the botch dice.

entries.name: Semyaza's Secret
entries.summary: Vis of Creo, Corpus and Herbam is interchangeable, and requisites among them may be ignored.
entries.description: A Secret of the Grigori, a Supernatural (Divine) Virtue. A holder who can use the Arts Creo, Corpus and Herbam may use vis of any of the three for the others, and ignore requisites among them. Using that vis, or a spell that ignores a requisite this way, in a Divine or Infernal aura doubles the botch dice.

entries.name: Shamsiel's Secret
entries.summary: Vis of Rego, Ignem and Vim is interchangeable, and requisites among them may be ignored.
entries.description: A Secret of the Grigori, a Supernatural (Divine) Virtue. A holder who can use the Arts Rego, Ignem and Vim may use vis of any of the three for the others, and ignore requisites among them. Using that vis, or a spell that ignores a requisite this way, in a Divine or Infernal aura doubles the botch dice. It also gives a Pious Flaw.

entries.name: Hyperborean Hymnist
entries.summary: Knows one Hyperborean hymn: the Hymn at 1 and 15 levels of Powers already infused. Repeatable.
entries.description: The character can recite one Hyperborean hymn, starting with that Hymn at 1 and 15 levels of Powers already infused. Taken again, it gives another hymn. Without The Gift, only this Virtue lets a character recite the hymns.

entries.name: Hyperborean Descent
entries.summary: -2 to Aging rolls, +1 against illness, may learn Magic Lore at creation; magical beings take to him.
entries.description: A descendant of Apollo's sun people: magical beings, spirits above all, treat him favorably. -2 to Aging rolls, +1 to resist illness, and he may learn Magic Lore at character creation. +2 to infusing hymn Powers.

entries.name: Hyperborean Descent
entries.summary: A Mythic Blood variant: glows at Warping Score 3+ and gains bird form or a flight power.
entries.description: A Mythic Blood variant for Hyperborean blood. He glows at Warping Score 3 or more, and gains a bird form or a flight power (Penetration +0, needing words and libations). +4 to infusing hymn Powers.

entries.name: Hyperborean Relic
entries.summary: Owns a Hyperborean relic holding 30 levels of Powers per time taken.
entries.description: The character owns a Hyperborean relic holding 30 levels of hymn Powers for each time this Virtue is taken.

entries.name: Canaanite Magic
entries.summary: Veil of Death range, an Arcane Connection to all the dead, +4 Penetration multiplier against them.
entries.description: The Hermetic integration of Canaanite necromancy (a Major breakthrough). The magus may use the Veil of Death range, holds a permanent Arcane Connection to all the dead and has a +4 Penetration multiplier against them. In return the dead sense him within seven miles and have a +4 Arcane Connection multiplier against him.

entries.name: Fertility Ritual Magic
entries.summary: May perform the Fertility Ritual, with fetishes made by the mothers.
entries.description: The Hermetic integration of the fertility cults (a 35-point Major breakthrough): the magus may lead the Fertility Ritual, in which mothers make fetishes under a supervisor who knows Fertility Lore.

entries.name: Grigori Legacy ({secret})
entries.summary: A Grigori Secret made Hermetic: its vis is interchangeable and its three Arts ignore requisites.
entries.description: The Hermetic integration of one Secret of the Grigori (a Major breakthrough per Secret), with the taint removed: vis of the Secret's three Arts may be used for one another, and spells in those Arts ignore requisites among them.

entries.name: Craft Mutable Device
entries.summary: Enchants an effect at +10 levels that can later be swapped for another of the same Arts.
entries.description: From Heron's mechanica (a Major breakthrough). An effect enchanted at 10 levels more can later, in a week and for a pawn of Vim vis, be changed to another effect of the same Technique and Form whose level is no higher. A second Major breakthrough makes the Virtue unnecessary.

entries.name: Awaken Device
entries.summary: Awakens an enchanted device as a magical being with Might of its material base + Magic Theory.
entries.description: From Heron's mechanica (a Major breakthrough, 30 points after Mutable Device). The magus awakens a device as a being of Might equal to its material base + Magic Theory, over seasons of Creo + the material's Form Lab Totals, for vis equal to its opening cost + a pawn per point of Might. One he awakened himself may become his familiar.

entries.name: Hermetic Rune Magic
entries.summary: Casts with the Rune duration and Inscription target; the effects are natural and need no vis.
entries.description: The Hermetic integration of active runes (a Major breakthrough). Rune Magic serves as Magic Theory for runes; spells may take the Rune duration (as Moon, lasting while the runes are whole) and the Inscription target (as Individual), carved at Touch. The effects are natural: they need no vis and pass Magic Resistance unless aimed at a being that has it.

entries.name: Mythic Farrier
entries.summary: Crafts horseshoes with magical effects in one Hermetic Form (Touched by Realm, limited); powers affect only the horse or its immediate surroundings.
entries.description: The character may use the Touched by (Realm) Virtue (City & Guild) to a limited extent. He may craft horseshoes with magical effects, using Hermetic guidelines for a single Hermetic Form chosen at character creation (Animal is a popular choice). The horseshoes' powers can only affect the horse itself or its immediate environment: a Terram effect making the ground the horse touches stable is allowed, an Auram power to change the weather is not. The Craft Total is the Craft: Farrier Ability plus Intelligence or Dexterity, a permanent choice made at character creation. Most likely aligned with the Magic or Faerie realm, though an Infernal farrier is possible. May be taken twice, but no more: the second time adds either a second Form or a second Ability, not both. For variations, rename it Mythic (Professional) and replace Craft: Farrier with another Craft Ability, keeping the limit of one Ability and one Form.

entries.name: Pack Mentality
entries.summary: A follower, not a leader: rarely takes the initiative, but sticks with a decisive leader once found.
entries.description: The character is a follower, not a leader. He rarely takes the initiative, but is usually happy to follow the direction of a forthright and decisive person. If he finds a leader, he tends to stick with him.

entries.name: Worthless Abilities
entries.summary: About 30 xp in Abilities made valueless by a shift in time (a time-lost character); companions may take it more than once.
entries.description: A time-lost character must have about 30 experience points that have been rendered valueless by her shift in time: for example, Area Lore 3 for a city that no longer exists, or an Etiquette score made useless by changing social structures. Troupes may permit companions to take this Flaw several times. For the legionaries of the Time-lost Witnesses template, the wasted Ability is their Organization Lore: the army it refers to no longer exists.

entries.name: Islamic Magic
entries.summary: Islamic Tradition: Formulaic and Ritual spells may use the Islamic Ranges, Durations and Targets; Theology: Islam is a Lab requisite for such spells.
entries.description: You belong to the Islamic Tradition of the Order, though you need not be a Muslim yourself. Your Formulaic and Ritual spells may use the Ranges, Durations and Targets that Blood and Sand calls Islamic, but you cannot use them in spontaneous magic. When you learn, invent or otherwise work in the laboratory with a spell that uses any of them, your Theology: Islam acts as a requisite on your Magic Theory; your work on ordinary Hermetic spells is unaffected. You begin with Theology: Islam 2 and a bad Reputation of 1 among Hermetic magi, who find your magic unsettling.

entries.name: Interfaith Magic
entries.summary: A gifted member of the Islamic Tradition: free use of the Islamic Ranges, Durations and Targets; may learn the Art in Arabic.
entries.description: You are an unusually able member of the Islamic Tradition, and may use the Islamic Ranges, Durations and Targets that Blood and Sand describes without limit, alongside the ordinary Hermetic ones. You begin with Theology: Islam 3 and a bad Reputation of 1 among Hermetic magi, whom your magic makes uneasy. If you like, you were taught the Art in Arabic: your House's starting Latin becomes Living Language: Arabic.

entries.name: Poorly-Meshed Hermetic-Islamic Magic
entries.summary: Trained mostly in Islamic magic: free use of the Islamic parameters, but ordinary Hermetic ones only in Formulaic and Ritual spells, and Theology: Islam is taken off Magic Theory in all Lab work.
entries.description: Your training was chiefly in Islamic magic, and the Order's own magic sits awkwardly with it. The Islamic Ranges, Durations and Targets that Blood and Sand describes are open to you without limit, but the ordinary Hermetic ones may be used only in Formulaic and Ritual spells, never in spontaneous magic. In every laboratory activity with a spell, Hermetic or Islamic, your Theology: Islam is subtracted from your Magic Theory. You learnt the Art in Arabic rather than Latin, so your House's starting Latin becomes Living Language: Arabic, and you begin with Theology: Islam 2 and a bad Reputation of 1 among Hermetic magi.

entries.name: The Faerie Problem
entries.summary: Trained only in the Levant, where faeries are scarce: a Faerie aura is subtracted from your magic rolls instead of helping them.
entries.description: You learnt your magic in the Levant and nowhere else, and the fay are so rare there that you have almost never met them. Within a Faerie aura, its strength counts against your spellcasting and other magic rolls, instead of the usual effect a Faerie aura has on Hermetic magic. Any Hermetic magus may take this Flaw, not only one of the Islamic Tradition. A magus who lives in a Faerie aura for some years may grow used to it, and the storyguide may then let the Flaw lapse.

entries.name: Confluence of the Realms
entries.summary: A lab text's realm may be changed when it is used again, and vis may be extracted in an aura of any realm.
entries.description: Conciatta's first breakthrough, gained by original research or integration (30 points). When you use a laboratory text, you may change the realm it names, so that a spell or enchantment meant for one realm (a ward, a spell against demons, one that senses or works on an aura) becomes a variant for another, with the same Range, Duration, Target and effect. This is done only in the laboratory, never in the field. You can also extract vis in an aura of any of the four realms: the extraction total takes the usual aura modifier, and the vis is that aura's, with whatever side effects it usually has (Legends of Hermes pp. 14-15).

entries.name: Insight of the Realms
entries.summary: A realm's Lore stands in for Artes Liberales or Philosophiae in Rituals and ceremonial casting there, and sees through its regio boundaries.
entries.description: Conciatta's second breakthrough, gained by original research or integration (30 points). In a Ritual or ceremonial casting within (or about) a realm, you may use that realm's Lore (Dominion, Faerie, Infernal or Magic Lore) in place of either Artes Liberales or Philosophiae. You may also use a realm's Lore to find and see through a regio boundary of that realm, in place of Second Sight or Sense Holiness and Unholiness; it counts as aligned to the aura it is used in, and takes its modifier (Legends of Hermes p. 15).

entries.name: True Understanding of the Realms
entries.summary: A foreign aura counts less by your Lore of its realm, for its penalty and its botch dice; a bonus it gives stays.
entries.description: Conciatta's last breakthrough, gained by original research or integration (45 points, or 30 once Confluence or Insight of the Realms is integrated). In an aura of another realm, its strength counts less by your score in that realm's Lore, never below 0, for its penalty and its extra botch dice; where the aura gives a bonus, as a Faerie aura does to Hermetic magic, you keep the bonus and lose only the botch dice. The aura's other effects fall by it too, such as the feeling an aligned Magic aura brings or an Abyssal regio's loss of Characteristics. It is part of your Gift, like your sigil, and cannot be suspended: a device keeps, for its Penetration, the Lore you had when you instilled each effect, and your talisman uses your Lore now (Legends of Hermes pp. 15-16).
